written.headline: Dropbox to acquire AI storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million
written.summary: Dropbox announced it will buy Tigris Data for $350 million, its largest acquisition to date. The deal gives Dropbox a cloud storage platform built for AI workloads and will be integrated into its new DBX Agent Cloud service.

written.headline: Nvidia uses full‑stack codesign to boost AI memory efficiency
written.summary: Nvidia says its full‑stack codesign of GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage and software increases useful work per byte of memory.
